newsitem.title: BRAZIL: German doctor, torture, murder suspect, kills self.
newsitem.headline: German doctor, torture, murder suspect, kills self.

text.p: A German doctor accused of murder and torture in Germany hanged himself on Monday in a Brazilian jail after learning he would be extradited to face trial in his home country, authorities said.
Gerd Wenzinger, 54, was found dead in his cell hanging from a piece of material torn from his pants, a jail official said in the northeastern city of Salvador in Bahia state.

"We had someone sleeping in his cell at night to monitor him but he was not being observed during the day," Ildomar Dias Rodeiro, director of Salvador's House of Detention, said. "He must have done this soon after eating breakfast this morning."

Jail officials said Wenzinger fell into a deep depression after Brazil's Supreme Court on Friday upheld an extradition request by prosecutors in Berlin. He was to have been extradited to Germany within two months, court officials said.

Local media said Wenzinger was a suspect in the murder of up to 13 prostitutes in Berlin and Stuttgart and the torture and sexual abuse of dozens more in Germany and Brazil. He was arrested by Brazilian police in Salvador in 1996 on charges of drugging and torturing women, many of them prostitutes.
